scene: You climb up onto the high platform where three major transports await.
picture: Flat side view along a high wooden transit deck. Far left sits an open-doored maglev dragon train. Left, the broad Pacific Islander man stands holding his ukulele and skewers. Right, a shiny pink bullet train awaits boarding. Far right, a wooden junk with glittering solar sails is tied to an ornate post.
shown: a sleek maglev dragon train waiting open-doored on the track on the far left
a gleaming pink bullet train idling with doors open on the right
a glowing solar-sail junk moored at the wooden dock on the far right
